note: Italian for DSH 0.1.6-alpha.2: the 325 keys the release adds and the 11 whose English text changed. The additions are 96 keys inside namespaces that already existed and 229 in four new ones (pluginManager, agent-team, sidebarBrowser, sidebarOffice). Values identical to English are deliberate: package names, URLs, paths, command tokens, the HFS/file formats and the Auto review feature name.
